label: Westermo Lynx 3510-F2G2.5-P8G-LV
description: Westermo Lynx 3510-F2G2.5-P8G-LV 10-port industrial managed Layer 2 PoE+ switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 with all eight ports 802.3at/af PoE+ PSE at up to 30 W a port inside a 240 W budget fed at 54 VDC, 2x 2.5 Gbit/s SFP cages, WeOS 5, -40 to +70 C.

poe.note: Datasheet power budget (PoE models): max. 240 W total PD consumption, max. 30 W per PoE port - 8 x 30 W is exactly 240 W, so all eight ports can be filled at full PoE+ only if the feed holds up. The box is rated 54 VDC; 802.3at needs 53-57 VDC and 802.3af 48-57 VDC, and PoE is unavailable below 48 V (12-57 VDC only when drawing no PoE load).

notes: Datasheet 'Lynx 3000 Series_2611_EN_REV.P'. All Lynx 3510 models are the 10-port chassis: 8 copper RJ45 plus 2 SFP cages, in 52 x 134 x 130 mm of full-metal IP40 housing at 1,100 g, DIN-rail or wall mount, -40 to +70 C operating (-40 to +85 C storage), 5-95% RH, 2,000 m altitude, 64 VLANs and 8 priority queues, 5-year warranty. Console is a USB-C port that emulates a serial port at 115200 bps; there is also a Micro SD slot (SD 2.0) and one digital input plus one digital output on screw terminals. Powered by WeOS 5: web UI over HTTP/HTTPS, CLI over console/SSHv2/Telnet, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 read-only MIBs, RADIUS/TACACS+, 802.1X, RSTP, LACP, FRNTv0/v2 and MRP ring recovery, DHCP server/relay/client, NTP, syslog. The datasheet gives no switching-capacity or MAC-table figure, so none is modelled here. Layer 2 PoE+ on the 2.5G SFP chassis; the copper ports are 10/100/1000BASE-T PoE+, not 2.5GBASE-T. Rated 54 VDC. MTBF Telcordia 638,000 h, MIL-HDBK-217F 583,000 h.
